verdict.rationale: HumanLayer orchestrates coding-agent sessions, and AI-generated insights over a user's data is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence never documents such a feature. The Advanced Metrics release note describes viewing usage, cost, and productivity metrics, not AI-generated insights or suggestions, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
